name: Electromagnetism.ElectromagneticPotential.time_deriv_time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema

lemma time_deriv_time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema {A : ElectromagneticPotential d}
    {𝓕 : FreeSpace}
    (hA : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A) (J : LorentzCurrentDensity d)
    (hJ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ J) (h : IsExtrema 𝓕 A J)
    (t : Time) (x : Space d) (i : Fin d) :
    ∂ₜ (∂ₜ (A.electricField 𝓕.c · x i)) t =
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * ∑ j, (∂[j] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i)) x) -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂[i] (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ·) x -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * 𝓕.μ₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
  let E := A.electricField 𝓕.c t
  have hEs : ∀ j, ContDiff ℝ 2 (fun y => E y j) :=
    fun j => electricField_apply_contDiff_space (i := j) (hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)) t
  have hEd : ∀ j k, Differentiable ℝ (∂[k] (fun y => E y j)) :=
    fun j k => Space.deriv_differentiable (hEs j) k
  have hBt : ∀ j, Differentiable ℝ
      (fun s => ∂[j] (fun y => A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c s y (j, i)) x) :=
    fun j => Space.space_deriv_differentiable_time (i := j)
      (magneticFieldMatrix_contDiff _ (hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)) (j, i)) x
  have hJt : Differentiable ℝ (fun s => J.currentDensity 𝓕.c s x i) :=
    LorentzCurrentDensity.currentDensity_apply_differentiable_time (hJ.differentiable (by simp)) x i
  let m := fun s => ∑ j, ∂[j] (A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c s · (j, i)) x
  have hBs : Differentiable ℝ m := Differentiable.fun_sum fun j _ => hBt j
  let a := 1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀)
  let b := 1 / 𝓕.ε₀
  let q := ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t
  let p := ∑ j, (∂[j] (∂[j] (E · i)) x)
  let r := ∂[i] (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ·) x
  calc _
    _ = a * ∂ₜ m t - b * q := by
      conv_lhs =>
        enter [1]
        change fun t => ∂ₜ (A.electricField 𝓕.c · x i) t
        enter [t]
        rw [Time.deriv_euclid (electricField_differentiable_time
          (hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)) _),
          time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema hA J hJ h]
      rw [Time.deriv_eq, fderiv_fun_sub (hBs.const_mul _).differentiableAt
        (hJt.const_mul _).differentiableAt]
      simp only [FunLike.coe_sub, Pi.sub_apply]
      rw [fderiv_const_mul hBs.differentiableAt, fderiv_const_mul hJt.differentiableAt]
      simp [a, b, q, Time.deriv_eq]
    _ = a *(∑ j, ∂[j] (fun x => ∂[j] (E · i) x -
        ∂[i] (E · j) x)) x -
        b * q := by
        apply congrArg (fun z : ℝ => a * z - b * q)
        calc
          ∂ₜ m t = (∑ j, ∂ₜ (fun t => ∂[j]
              (A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c t · (j, i)) x)) t := by
            rw [Time.deriv_eq, fderiv_fun_sum fun i _ => (hBt i).differentiableAt]
            simp only [FunLike.coe_sum, Finset.sum_apply]
            rfl
          _ = (∑ j, ∂[j] (fun x => ∂ₜ (A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c · x (j, i)) t)) x := by
            simp only [Finset.sum_apply]
            congr
            funext k
            rw [Space.time_deriv_comm_space_deriv]
            exact magneticFieldMatrix_contDiff _ (hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)) _
          _ = _ := by
            simp only [Finset.sum_apply]
            congr
            funext k
            congr
            funext x
            rw [time_deriv_magneticFieldMatrix _ (hA.of_le (ENat.LEInfty.out))]
    _ = (a * ∑ j, (∂[j] (fun x => ∂[j] (E · i) x) x -
          ∂[j] (fun x => ∂[i] (E · j) x) x)) -
          b * q := by
        congr
        simp only [Finset.sum_apply]
        congr
        funext j
        exact congrFun (Space.deriv_sub _ _ (hEd _ _) (hEd _ _)) x
    _ = a * p -
          a * ∑ j, (∂[j] (fun x => ∂[i] (E · j) x) x) - b * q := by simp [p, mul_sub]
    _ = a * p - a * (∂[i] (fun x => (∇ ⬝ E) x) x) - b * q := by
      apply congrArg (fun z : ℝ => a * p - a * z - b * q)
      trans (∑ j, ∂[i] (fun x => ∂[j] (E · j) x) x)
      · congr
        funext j
        exact congrFun (Space.deriv_commute _ (hEs j)) x
      · change _ = ∂[i] (fun x => ∑ j, ∂[j] (E · j) x) x
        rw [Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis, fderiv_fun_sum]
        simp [← Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis]
        exact fun j _ => (hEd j j).differentiableAt
    _ = a * p -
          1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀ ^ 2) * r -
          b * q := by
        congr 2
        rw [isExtrema_iff_gauss_ampere_magneticFieldMatrix] at h
        conv_lhs =>
          enter [2, 2, x]
          rw [(h t x).1]
        trans a * Space.deriv i
            (fun x => (1/ 𝓕.ε₀) * LorentzCurrentDensity.chargeDensity 𝓕.c J t x) x
        · congr
          funext x
          ring
        · rw [Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis]
          rw [fderiv_const_mul]
          simp [a, r, ← Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis]
          field_simp
          apply Differentiable.differentiableAt
          apply LorentzCurrentDensity.chargeDensity_differentiable_space
          exact hJ.differentiable (by simp)
        · exact hA
        · exact hJ
      _ = 𝓕.c ^ 2 * ∑ j, (∂[j] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i)) x) -
            𝓕.c ^ 2 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂[i] (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ·) x -
            𝓕.c ^ 2 * 𝓕.μ₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
          simp [a, b, E, p, q, r, FreeSpace.c_sq]
          field_simp
